strings.name: Carver Mead
strings.summary: At Caltech, Mead studied semiconductors and computing and worked with Lynn Conway to spread structured VLSI design, opening chip design to more students and designers. He connected analog circuits with neural systems and supported related ventures. An emeritus professor since 1999, he continued research spanning device physics, design education and new computing architectures.
